Remark
[Extension to $\overline{D(\partial I)}$] ↗ thm:solution-of-gradient-flow 1. ch9:9.6.2-rem-2\group Nonlinear Semigroups

For $\mathbf u,\mathbf v\in D(\partial I)$, the limiting flow satisfies \[ \| S(t)\mathbf{u} - S(t)\mathbf{v}\| \leq \| \mathbf{u} - \mathbf{v}\| \quad (t \geq 0) \] and therefore extends uniquely to a nonlinear contraction semigroup on $\overline{D(\partial I)}$. Under (8), this space is $H$.
